title: Bronze Age collapse: verify Sea Peoples ethnonyms, Peloponnese population decline, Sanxingdui correlation
question: What is the current scholarly state on (a) the identities of the Sea Peoples named in Egyptian sources — especially "Weshesh", still listed as "Unbekannt [S]" — (b) the claimed ~90% population decline on the Peloponnese, and (c) the ~1100 BCE collapse of Sanxingdui and whether it plausibly correlates with the Mediterranean Late Bronze Age collapse?
why_now: OTA-HIS-0007-1200BCE-DE is the canonical history bridge that makes the Bronze Age collapse the "central trauma" of the Baumeister network. It carries several [R]-labeled figures (90% Peloponnese decline, Qatna destruction ~1340 BCE) and open historical-linguistic identifications (Weshesh). Updating its factual layer against post-2014 scholarship, Aegean demography studies, and Sanxingdui excavation reports would materially raise educational quality and plausibility; the Cline-parallel is reused across the NOXIA saga and referenced by KARTE/ARC documents.
